# Goal

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Goal>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)

A described state of affairs that an agent may want, intend, or commit to bring about — the propositional content of the intentional modes, existing by social convention like every description (a [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)). A goal asserts nothing and prescribes nothing by itself: it is satisfied by situations ([`gmeow:satisfiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-satisfiedBy.md)), held by agents ([`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) or the reified modes), and partly defined by its named shadow ([`gmeow:counterGoal`](../properties/gmeow-counterGoal.md)). Whether a given situation satisfies the goal is a vantage-indexed claim ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
